name: example
title: Example document — replace with your own
domain_context: One paragraph telling the translator what this document is, who wrote it, and what conventions to hold: which terms stay verbatim (part numbers, tool numbers, drawing references), how captions are labelled, and the register to translate into.
notes: Config-only example: no source/ or artifacts/ ship with the repo. Copy this directory anywhere outside the repo, drop your PDF in source/, and point the pipeline at that path.
